candidate_facts.name: Ammonium chloride
candidate_facts.designation: J. T. Baker Chemical Company sample (no specimen number reported)
candidate_facts.sample: Section 2.33, printed pp. 59-60 / PDF pp. 63-64: J. T. Baker sample, NBS chemical laboratory ACS compliance and sublimation recrystallization.
candidate_facts.density_locator: Section 2.33, printed p. 61 / PDF p. 65, left column: simple cubic structure, one molecule per unit cell and NBS crystallographic density 1.527 at 26 degrees C.
candidate_facts.purity: NH4Cl, simple cubic. The NBS chemical laboratory found the source sample to conform with ACS standards. No numeric total purity, water content or impurity-free status is established.
candidate_facts.processing: The sample was recrystallized by sublimation before X-ray exposure; no preparation temperature or duration is supplied.

candidate_facts.name: Lithium chloride
candidate_facts.designation: Mallinckrodt Chemical Works sample labelled SDD
candidate_facts.sample: Section 2.35, printed p. 62 / PDF p. 66: Mallinckrodt sample labelled SDD, supplier chemical analysis and loosely packed NBS powder preparation to avoid orientation.
candidate_facts.density_locator: Section 2.35, printed p. 62 / PDF p. 66, right column: NaCl structure with four molecules per cell and density calculated from the NBS lattice constant, 2.074 at 25 degrees C.
candidate_facts.purity: LiCl, cubic NaCl type. A supplier chemical analysis accompanies the SDD sample; selected reported entries are iron 0.001 percent and other alkalis 0.02 percent. This is not the complete impurity list. Percentage basis, numeric total purity and measured water content are not established.
candidate_facts.processing: The NBS intensity measurements used loosely packed powder expressly prepared to avoid preferred orientation. This preparation does not establish a measured powder-packing density.
candidate_facts.extra_scope: SDD is a source sample label, not a separately qualified grade. The density reference temperature is 25 degrees C; no powder-pattern temperature from the neighboring LiF table is assigned to LiCl.

candidate_facts.name: Potassium fluoride
candidate_facts.designation: J. T. Baker Chemical Company sample (no specimen number reported)
candidate_facts.sample: Section 2.37, printed p. 64 / PDF p. 68: J. T. Baker sample, supplier chemical analysis, approximately 0.1 percent sodium in NBS spectrographic analysis, drying at 220 degrees C and petrolatum mounting.
candidate_facts.density_locator: Section 2.37, printed p. 65 / PDF p. 69, upper text: NaCl structure with four molecules per cell and density calculated from the NBS lattice constant, 2.524 at 26 degrees C.
candidate_facts.purity: KF, cubic NaCl type, with reported impurities. NBS spectrographic analysis indicates approximately 0.1 percent sodium. The source separately discusses 0.1 percent sodium fluoride in solid solution and its influence on lattice size; these statements are not equated as an exact measured solid-solution composition. Percentage basis and total purity are not established. No pure or undoped specimen claim is made.
candidate_facts.processing: Because the material is very deliquescent, the sample was dried at 220 degrees C and then mixed with petrolatum before X-ray mounting. Drying duration and measured residual water are not supplied. Petrolatum is an XRD preparation aid, not a new composite-density observation.
candidate_facts.extra_scope: This source-qualified KF phase retains the stated sodium impurity and solid-solution qualification; no perfectly pure KF, petrolatum mixture density or additional material identity is inferred.
candidate_facts.pattern: Printed p. 65 / PDF p. 69, Table 38: NBS powder-pattern temperature is 26 degrees C.
